tokenRepresentationNote: Verified live on 2026-11-15: the fest faucet credits Fest USD (0x97143B771D34ddb9130b807b135Ae675A5a963CA) and Fest ETH (0x02292293c13880a26242690eb70a0e42B8E91c28) in the NATIVE 'erc20:<addr>' bank-denom representation. The EVM-lane ERC-20 contracts are separate ledgers: ERC-20 balanceOf(owner) = 0 for both, totalSupply (1e15 fUSD / 1e24 fETH) sits with the fest distributor, no Transfer events appear in recent blocks, and @qorechain/sdk 0.14.0 exposes no conversion helper. GuardianVault is token-agnostic, so the live demo trades the project's own ERC-20 pair (above) at the same denominations the guard caps were designed around (6-decimal spend). A MockAMM bound to the REAL fest pair was also deployed as a wiring artifact: 0xd1c8ffd9f63354b95c632ef30f4010bfc8549fae (deploy tx 0x4784de7360047de24b4fffd0a5093342c0371d155dca51612ed64cc061fd1eb8). Pointing the vault at the ERC-20 fest pair is a constructor-argument change once the account holds the ERC-20 form.
